beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part three. Surface energy: an opacity-blur entrance, color interpolation sweeping path by path, a kinetic scatter where all forty-seven paths explode then spring back, and glitch slices that snap clean. The mark barely moves. The surface does the work.

Let's recap with Claude. Blur arrival, color sweep path by path, forty-seven paths scatter and spring home, glitch snaps clean. Emphasis moves — all four of them. None of these are entrances or exits. They live in the middle of a sequence, between a hold and whatever comes next.

Your turn. Paste this: scatter all paths in my logo outward from center, then spring them back home — and tell me whether it reads as chaos-resolving or explosion. The answer tells you whether you own the move.
